top: The eternal God is thy refuge,
bottom: and underneath are the everlasting arms...

top: Be strong and of a good courage;
bottom: ...the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

top: Joshua said unto the people, Shout;
bottom: for the LORD hath given you the city.

top: ...the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man:
bottom: for the LORD fought for Israel.

top: Now therefore give me this mountain...
bottom: if so be the LORD will be with me...

top: How long are ye slack to go to possess the land,
bottom: which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?

top: But the mountain shall be thine;
bottom: ...for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites...
